title: ConfigObj应用配置工作场景
description: 固定真实源码上的完整工程交付：深复制仍保留原始插值表达式与配置图；递归合并时保留新增节注释且解除源对象共享；把真实编码配置完整写入后原子发布；组合标量归一化与逐元素真实类型验证；提供不泄露原值且形状固定的真实校验报告；重载真实配置并验证成功后才接管旧树。每项均包含调查、方案确认、实现、独立验收及失败返工；原项目研究另保留。

tasks.prompt:
Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Fix deepcopy(Section/ConfigObj) to copy raw stored values rather than interpolated items. Preserve same concrete types, raw expressions, nested list expressions, comments/default metadata and internal parent/main graph links using the deepcopy memo. Cached interpolation engines must bind to the cloned sections. Copies must independently recalculate after root/nested changes; creating a copy must not trigger interpolation loops. Preserve the explicit evaluated semantics of Section.dict(), ordinary retrieval and existing pickle behavior.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/tests/test_development_configobj_o01_dev.py and concise Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-configobj-o01-dev.md. Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.

Extend Section.merge(indict, *, comments="incoming") so Section inputs retain raw interpolations, key/section comments and inline comments while cloning incoming data and rebinding newly inserted sections to the target main/parent/depth. Default incoming metadata wins; comments="existing" retains metadata of preexisting names; repeated merges do not accumulate duplicate comments. Add ConfigObj.write_atomic(filename=None), preserving ordinary write/outfile behavior. Serialize a raw-preserving clone through the real ConfigObj writer before opening any temporary file; use a unique same-directory temporary, preserve existing permission bits or use 0600 for a new file, close before os.replace and clean only the operation temp on failure. Default to self.filename, support PathLike, reject missing destination and symlink targets, return the absolute destination. Serialization/encoding/replace errors must preserve old bytes and original in-memory metadata. Do not promise power-loss durability or cross-file atomicity.
